question: Which of the following art form is performed by men, in which their body is stained with 'Ramras' and they dance with 'Kartal' while singing ordinarily wearing yellow clothes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chaiti.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Chaiti **art form is performed by men, in which their body is stained with** 'Ramras' and they dance with 'Kartal'** while singing ordinarily wearing yellow clothes.
 
• **Chaiti **is sung in the month of Chait that falls in March/April as per the Hindu calendar.
 
• This is certainly a season-specific song.
 
• This season has great importance in the largely agrarian society of Eastern Uttar Pradesh and Bihar for this is the season of harvest.
 
• And what is typical to all the festivals, song and dance are a must.
 
• The Hindu festival of colour called Holi falls in this season only and that is why many of the Chaiti songs have references to Holi.
